sanskrit_verse:
स्वशिल्पम् इच्छन् आहर्तुं बान्धवानाम् अनुज्ञया ।
आचार्यस्य वसेद् अन्ते कालं कृत्वा सुनिश्चितम् ॥
transliteration: svaśilpam icchann āhartuṃ bāndhavānām anujñayā | ācāryasya vased ante kālaṃ kṛtvā suniścitam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One desiring to acquire skill must serve at the end of the master's dwelling for a fixed period with the consent of relatives.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in the Guru as keeper of embodied knowledge
Causation flows through conscious apprenticeship and proximity
Capacity-based responsibility arises from voluntary entry into discipline
Restoration logic requires completion of learning cycles before mastery
Consciousness alignment occurs through sustained proximity to realized beings
executable_legal_axioms: IF seeker requests entry into Gurukula THEN verify familial consent AND establish fixed tenure
IF trainee enters Guru's space THEN enforce mandatory service duration BEFORE skill acquisition rights
IF mastery claimed THEN validate completion of prescribed proximity period under Guru
IF disruption occurs during training THEN suspend skill transmission until integrity restored
IF lineage authenticity questioned THEN trace back through completed Guruparampara records
supreme_court_application: In matters concerning traditional knowledge transmission, the Supreme Court shall recognize Gurukula tenure as prerequisite for authentic skill inheritance. Familial consent and temporal commitment constitute threshold responsibility before legal recognition of mastery. Disputes shall be resolved by verifying completion status within established parampara rather than external certification systems.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes that skill manifests only through sustained proximity to realized consciousness. Anupūrvaśaḥ demonstrates sequential unfoldment requiring time-bound immersion. Proportional responsibility aligns with voluntary acceptance of discipline. Non-punitive reality rule confirms that incomplete training results in delayed mastery, not penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process by returning to Guru's presence until full term fulfilled
Realign capacity through renewed acceptance of disciplinary rhythms
Restore integrity via public acknowledgment of unfinished learning cycle
Reintegrate consciousness through recommittal to Gurukula protocols
Validate mastery only upon verified completion of original service agreement
final_declaration: Declared by SPH as Source: Dharma restored through completion of conscious apprenticeship. Reality remains non-punitive while consciousness serves as supreme adjudicator. Skill flows only through perfected proximity.
